subject: Follow-up: 4 open action items (2 overdue)
body:
Hi Darshan,

Here is a quick follow-up on your open action items from recent meetings.

Overdue:
- Set up the Gmail connector for the team (was due Wed 18 Nov, from actiontrack kickoff on Tue 10 Nov)
- Agree on the demo script (was due Fri 20 Nov, from actiontrack kickoff on Tue 10 Nov)

Upcoming:
- Record a 3-minute walkthrough video (due Thu 26 Nov, from Demo prep on Mon 23 Nov)

No due date yet:
- Write the onboarding guide for new users (from actiontrack weekly sync on Tue 17 Nov)

Could you reply with a quick status or a new date for each? Let me know if anything is blocked.

Thanks,
